head: 2cb6f69ffbf9ee66f7053ed7b40e5c8711ba1ea2
headKind: Implementation commit; subsequent report-only commit leaves implementation/tests unchanged.
decision: 805-preserve-unverified-goal-coverage accepted in planRevision612; no new first-response wait/retry budget.
cause: Provider errors were converted to attention items with zero observed active work, but without an availability distinction. The collector labeled this idle, and the drain planner discarded a previously active tracker and planned a wake. The first healthy restarted runtime can legitimately return rebuilding before query coverage is initialized even though hello succeeds. A failed fresh provider read could also leave an older verified provider cache available to a later explicit inspection.
implementation: BackgroundProviderSnapshot and aggregate ActivitySnapshot expose optional coverage=verified/unverified. Successful legacy providers remain compatible; explicitly unverified provider responses are preserved. Exceptions always mark provider coverage unverified, retain existing diagnostic attention item and propagate aggregate unverified category. Counts still describe observed rows; no invented active task or verified-empty claim.

Drain planner retains exactly the current active goal's last verified tracker while coverage is unverified, without emitting a wake or replacing its signature with a partial observation. Paused/completed/replaced goal fences remain prior to this guard. A later verified-empty publication drains exactly once.

Actual Goal automatic idle/settled/restored/preference/audit paths respect unknown coverage, cancel a pending idle wake, and do not infer drained work. Question harvest cannot fabricate finished work from unverified absence. Existing authority, admission, branch/generation and recipient rules remain. Prompt/summary explicitly identify unverified background activity.

Provider cache invalidation on failed fresh reads uses existing execution/provider/sequence fences. A stale older success or failure cannot overwrite a newer observation, and a later explicit inspection cannot resurrect an older verified cache after a failure. No retry or new polling path added.

Standalone cold/recovery fixture uses a shared test-only goalActivityWhenReady helper: register production provider notifications, inspect the existing subscribed snapshot, reject actual degraded coverage, and resolve actual provider activity only after source-ready publication. It never treats hello as source-ready, sleeps, creates a timer or queries full state periodically. Same helper is exercised by the actual-component regression.

Original standalone900000ms fixture deadline remains unchanged. Cold/recovery child processes receive that existing test AbortSignal so an unfinished readiness publication cannot outlive the original fixture. All original item/owner/registration/crash/receipt assertions retained with only the accepted subscribed-readiness call substitution. Fixture context supplies an empty actual test branch; no production identity/authority manufacture.

causalRed.expectedFailure: unverified coverage cannot prove that previously active work drained: actual existing-goal:previous-task:running vs expected null
causalRed.boundary: Actual model/WorkClient/provider/collector counterexample, before production edit; not a fabricated snapshot-only counterexample.

causalAndCallerGreen.actualComponents: Real WorkReadModel/SQLite, WorkQueries, WorkClient, checkHello, registered Background provider, backgroundGoalObservation, collector and drain planner. In-memory frame transport/source hint adapter only; no native daemon/installer/socket replay or substitute ready projection.
causalAndCallerGreen.sequence: hello succeeds with initialization.attempts0; first provider read promptly rejects rebuilding under the existing400ms focused bound; collector returns explicit unverified/provider-error; previously active tracker remains and wake=null; shared standalone fixture helper remains pending despite hello; ordinary model.reconcile publishes ready through SAME subscription; helper and collector return verified empty; preserved tracker emits exactly one drain wake; subsequent reads/wake planning do not duplicate it.
causalAndCallerGreen.noPolling: Five warmed provider reads and recovery publication add no get RPC or resubscribe. No readiness timer, wait budget, busy loop or retry opportunity added.
causalAndCallerGreen.actualGoalExtension: Both thrown-provider and explicit-unverified cases exercise actual Goal notification/cache/publish/agent_settled handling. Failed fresh read cannot resurrect a verified cache. Advancing original mock timers60000ms creates no wake/query while unknown; verified notification clears unknown and drains once; another60000ms produces no duplicate wake. Existing generation/pause/resume/hold/completion tests also pass.
causalAndCallerGreen.mixedCoverage: Known active rows remain observable while another provider is unverified; no partial observation overwrites prior verified tracker. Unknown coverage neither transfers tracker to another goal nor retains it for a paused goal.
